source.title: Lieutenancies Act 1997, Schedule 1
source.licence: Crown copyright. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

method: All 33 London records and all 63 English unitary records reviewed against the current schedule. The other 265 records retain existing county membership or blanks, with the applicable schedule provision recorded. Welsh principal areas and Scottish council areas are explicitly noted. GSS codes identify registry records and are not claimed to appear in the Act. This reference is maintained independently of the registry builder.

Cheshire.quote: Cheshire East, Cheshire West and Chester, and, Halton and Warrington

Dorset.quote: Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole and Dorset

Durham.quote: Durham, Darlington, Hartlepool and so much of Stockton-on-Tees as lies north of the line for the time being of the centre of the River Tees

The East Riding of Yorkshire.quote: The East Riding of Yorkshire and Kingston upon Hull (City of)

East Sussex.quote: East Sussex and Brighton and Hove

Lincolnshire.quote: Lincolnshire, North Lincolnshire and North East Lincolnshire

North Yorkshire.quote: North Yorkshire, Middlesbrough, Redcar and Cleveland, York and so much of Stockton-on-Tees as lies south of the line for the time being of the centre of the River Tees

Somerset.quote: Somerset, Bath and North East Somerset and North Somerset.

London.quote: Greater London (excluding the City of London);

OtherEnglishCounties.quote: any other areas in England which are counties for the purposes of the Local Government Act 1972.

City.quote: The City of London shall be treated as a county for the purposes of sections 5 and 6.

Scilly.quote: The Isles of Scilly shall be treated as part of the county of Cornwall for the purposes of this Act.

Wales.quote: The counties in Wales for the purposes of this Act are the preserved counties, that is to say, the counties in Wales as they stood immediately before the passing of the Local Government (Wales) Act 1994 (but subject to any redrawing of their boundaries by or under that Act or the Local Government Act 1972).

Scotland.quote: the cities of Aberdeen, Dundee, Edinburgh and Glasgow;

Scope.quote: The provisions of this Schedule identify the areas which constitute counties in England, counties in Wales or areas in Scotland for the purposes of the lieutenancies in Great Britain.
